read: Margins are squeezed: hashprice sits in the bottom 23% of the last three years and an average-efficiency fleet (loses money at $0.07/kWh); yet hashrate is still growing and the next difficulty adjustment is projected +2.8%, so miners are adding machines rather than capitulating. Over the last 30 days, spot ETF inflows have covered newly mined supply about 1.5x.
